# ThirdParty

`onnxruntime-swift-package-manager/` is an unmodified copy of microsoft/onnxruntime-swift-package-manager at tag
1.24.2 (commit b7fb7f7dea8a2469e6335d95a61b8f36d0dc83b2), MIT licence (see its LICENSE). The upstream GitHub
repository stopped resolving (404) on 2026-11-17, which broke clean builds; the package's binary targets still download
from download.onnxruntime.ai with their pinned SHA-256 checksums. Replace with the upstream URL again if it returns.
